news.title: 2 Cobb County brothers reported missing found safe; third child also located
news.summary: Two brothers, ages 12 and 15, reported missing in Cobb County have been found safe. Police say a third child who was with them was also found safe.

news.title: 3 missing runaway boys found safe in Atlanta, Cobb police say
news.summary: A desperate Cobb County mother is pleading for the safe return of her two young sons after the brothers disappeared following a scolding over missed school.

news.title: 20-year-old motorcyclist killed in Cobb County crash
news.summary: A motorcyclist was killed in a crash involving a pickup truck Tuesday afternoon at a busy Cobb County intersection.

news.title: Rapper Rod Wave indicted on gun, drug charges after Atlanta arrest
news.summary: Rapper Rod Wave is facing three felony gun and drug counts in Fulton County stemming from an alleged speeding incident in Atlanta last year, according to an indictment obtained by Billboard.

news.title: Driver killed in accident on I-20 involving fire truck identified
news.summary: A crash on the Georgia interstate on Wednesday morning is confirmed to be deadly.

news.title: Rapper Rod Wave indicted on drug, weapons charges
news.summary: An indictment was handed down on Oct. 30 and unsealed this month. The rapper was facing charges stemming from an arrest in Atlanta last year.

news.title: Motorcyclist dies in Tuesday crash with pickup truck in Kennesaw
news.summary: A 20-year-old Woodstock motorcyclist died Tuesday afternoon after a pickup truck turned left into his path at a busy Kennesaw intersection, Cobb County police said.

news.title: Woodstock outlet mall Nike theft uncovered $39,000 retail crime ring across six counties: DA

news.title: Woman found dead behind abandoned Bartow County house identified

news.title: 2 Coweta County teens killed in crash identified, third boy critical
news.summary: Two East Coweta High School students are dead and a third is clinging to life in an Atlanta hospital after a car traveling over 100 mph crashed.

news.title: Family increasing reward for information on Union City homicide
news.summary: According to authorities, Christopher Kindle was shot multiple times on the evening of Nov. 25, 2018, at the Shannon Lake apartments on Buffington Road.
